生成された動画：=== REFERENCES ===

Use the provided Riven, Ally Soldier, HOME/VILLAGE, ROAD TO HOME VILLAGE,
and starting-frame references.

Use the references for visual continuity throughout the video.

At the beginning, Riven is beside Ally Soldier on the mountain road.

Far away below them, her home village is burning beneath large columns of smoke.

Maintain the established cinematic world, costume, environment, sword,
character scale, and atmosphere throughout the video.


=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Grounded photorealistic realism.

Natural human movement.

Natural cinematic camera movement and clean cuts.

Late-afternoon mountain atmosphere.

Natural fire, smoke, wind, footsteps, and breathing.

English voice.

Natural lip sync.

No subtitles.

No background music.

Keep the visual storytelling simple and clear.


=== VIDEO SUMMARY ===

Riven rises beside Ally Soldier and looks toward the distant burning village.

She suddenly remembers her father is still there.

She quietly says:

"Father..."

Then she runs toward home.

Use smoke as a cinematic transition to skip the long journey.

Smoke fills the frame while Riven is running.

When the smoke clears, Riven is already entering the burning village.

She runs through the village searching for her father and calls for him.

As she moves deeper between the houses, she notices the first subtle sign
that something about the destruction is unusual.

End there.

Do not reveal any mysterious figure yet.


=== SHOTS ===

Shot 1 — FATHER

Begin close to Riven.

Ally Soldier is resting on the ground beside her.

Riven slowly rises to her feet.

She remains still for a brief moment.

Then she looks toward the distant valley.

Show Riven's point of view:

far below, her home village is burning.

The village is very distant and small within the enormous mountain landscape.

Large dark smoke columns rise above it.

Cut back to Riven.

Her expression changes as she remembers someone is still there.

Quietly:

"Father..."

Riven immediately turns and starts running toward home.

Follow close behind her.

Do not show the entire journey.

Keep the camera close to Riven as she runs.


Shot 2 — SMOKE TRANSITION

Riven continues running.

The camera tracks close beside her.

Wind moves through her pale-blonde hair and clothing.

As she runs, dark smoke gradually moves across the frame.

The smoke becomes thicker.

Riven becomes partially obscured.

Eventually the smoke completely fills the camera view.

Use the moving smoke as a natural cinematic transition.

CUT THROUGH THE SMOKE.

Keep smoke covering most of the frame during the cut.

As the smoke begins to clear, reveal a different location.

Riven is now running along the main road inside her home village.

The transition represents the passage of travel time.

Do not show Riven traveling continuously from the mountain road into the village.


Shot 3 — HOME

Continue tracking Riven as she runs through the village.

Damaged wooden houses stand along the road.

Small fires burn around parts of the village.

Smoke drifts naturally between the buildings.

Ash moves through the air.

Riven looks rapidly from side to side while running.

She searches the houses and doorways.

She calls loudly:

"FATHER!"

No answer.

Riven continues deeper into the village.

"FATHER!"

Only the distant sound of fire responds.

Her pace gradually slows.

She looks around.

Something about the village feels strangely quiet.


Shot 4 — THE FIRST CLUE

Riven walks farther between the houses.

Keep the camera closer now.

She passes a damaged wooden structure.

Then she suddenly stops.

Something on the wooden wall catches her attention.

Riven slowly approaches.

Among the ordinary soot and burned wood is a strange dark trace.

It looks different from the surrounding fire damage.

The mark is irregular and unnaturally dark.

It has no glow.

It has no visible magical energy.

Keep it subtle and grounded.

Riven looks at it carefully.

She does not understand what it is.

She slowly reaches closer—

A faint sound comes from somewhere deeper inside the village.

Riven immediately stops.

She turns toward the sound.

Hold on Riven looking into the smoke-filled road ahead.

Nothing is clearly visible.

Riven quietly says:

"Father?"

The distant smoke moves between the empty houses.

Hold for a moment.

CUT.、16:9
